summary.text: Stephen Ferrucci III is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 71, in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent William Pizzuto (R).
He previously ran for the same seat in 2018.

paragraphs.text: Stephen Ferrucci III was the Democratic candidate in the 2018 general election for District 71, in which incumbent Anthony D'Amelio (R) received 59.0 percent of the vote, Ferrucci 37.1 percent and Danielle Albert of the Independent Party of Connecticut 3.9 percent.
